mapper.select: SELECT base.date, base.calories, base.steps, IFNULL(sleep.total_sleep_minutes, 0) AS sleepMinutes FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(hd.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(sd.calories) AS calories, SUM(sd.steps) AS steps FROM health_data hd JOIN step_data sd ON hd.record_id = sd.record_id WHERE hd.user_id = #{userId} AND hd.data_type = 'STEPS' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(hd.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ) AS base LEFT JOIN ( SELECT hd.user_id, DATE(hd.timestamp) AS date, SUM(sd.duration_min) AS total_sleep_minutes FROM health_data hd JOIN sleep_data sd ON hd.record_id = sd.record_id WHERE hd.user_id = #{userId} AND hd.data_type = 'SLEEP' GROUP BY hd.user_id, DATE(hd.timestamp) ) AS sleep ON base.date = sleep.date ORDER BY base.date ASC;
